limits.en: 100 CU-hours/project, 0.5 GB storage per project, up to 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 5 GB network egress, 6-hour point-in-time history window.

keyLimits.en: Pay-as-you-go with no monthly minimum: compute at $0.106/CU-hour, storage at $0.35/GB-month (unlimited), up to 100 projects, 10 branches/project, 500 GB network egress included, up to 7-day history window, autoscaling up to 16 CU.

Pay-as-you-go: compute at $0.222/CU-hour, storage at $0.35/GB-month (unlimited), up to 1,000 projects, 25 branches/project, 500 GB network egress included, up to 30-day history window, autoscaling up to 56 CU.

addOns.en: Extra branches beyond plan limit: $1.50/month each on Launch and Scale.

cautions.en: Both paid tiers are pure usage billing with no flat monthly price; actual monthly cost depends on compute-hours and storage consumed, not a fixed seat price.

capabilities.en: Serverless Postgres with autoscaling compute and scale-to-zero when idle.
Instant database branching for creating isolated copies of a database for development, testing or preview environments.
Point-in-time restore within a configurable history window (6 hours to 30 days depending on plan).

limitations.en: Free plan storage is capped at only 0.5 GB per project, limiting it to prototypes and small side projects.
No flat-rate plan: cost predictability requires actively monitoring compute-hour and storage usage under the pay-as-you-go model.

reason.en: Direct competitor offering managed Postgres with a similar free tier and developer-first branching workflow.
Alternative backend-as-a-service with managed database and scale-to-zero-style free tier for small projects.

missingAlternatives.name: PlanetScale
missingAlternatives.reason: Serverless database competitor (MySQL-based) with branching, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Business and Enterprise plan pricing/limits not detailed on the fetched pricing page (only Free, Launch and Scale were shown).
